name: Griffophone Rider
storyline:
In GRIFFOPHONE RIDER, the world of Algator37 has been transformed into a massive motocross playground filled with dangerous hills, jumps and unpredictable terrain.

Griffophone takes on the role of the main rider and sets out on a journey across 50 increasingly challenging levels. Along the way, he encounters several familiar characters from the Algator37 universe, each with their own motorcycle appearance.

The objective is simple: reach the end of every course, collect as many stars as possible and master spectacular motorcycle tricks. Every jump is an opportunity to perform flips, wheelies and stoppies while trying to keep control of the bike and avoid crashing.

As the levels become harder, the courses demand greater precision and better control. Only the most skilled riders will be able to complete all 50 levels and become the ultimate rider of the Algator37 universe.
summary:
GRIFFOPHONE RIDER is a 2D arcade motocross game where players control a rider across challenging tracks filled with hills, jumps, steep slopes and dangerous terrain.

The gameplay focuses on physics-based motorcycle control. Players can accelerate, brake and control the bike's rotation to maintain balance and perform successful landings. While airborne, players can perform backflips and frontflips, while wheelies and stoppies can be performed on the ground.

Each level features varied terrain and collectible stars placed throughout the course. Performing tricks and collecting stars increases the player's score, while chaining successful tricks allows players to build combos and achieve higher scores.

The game features up to 50 levels with increasing difficulty, as well as a customization system for the rider, bike and background. Several characters are available, including Algator37, Antoff, YooGos and Sophie, alongside a mysterious character.

With its physics-based arcade gameplay, motorcycle tricks, collectible stars, progression system and Algator37 universe, GRIFFOPHONE RIDER offers a fast-paced experience focused on skill, tricks and high scores.
